swimming_pool.evidence: The turquoise pool at the right edge belongs to a neighboring lot, not the central lot. No pool is visible on the central lot.

detached_structure.evidence: A small gray-roofed structure sits just east of the house, behind a wooden deck. It could be a shed or a small outbuilding.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray shingled roof in fairly uniform condition and a rear deck. Large trees shade the west and east sides of the lot, and a neighbor's pool is visible to the east.
